title: Real-Time Autonomous Collision Avoidance of LEO Satellites
authors: **J. Saleem**, I. Gouveia, H. J. Hadi, R. Yasmin, A. Shoker
venue: Space Debris Conference 2026 · Saudi Space Agency · Riyadh
summary: Collision avoidance today waits on ground analysts and stale data. We propose discovery and agreement protocols so satellites can coordinate a manoeuvre themselves over inter-satellite links.
keyResult: ISL relay cuts CDM delivery from about 90 minutes to under 8
